official_definition: At the start of each opposing step, you can send a core from the opposing Field/Reserve to the Trash. Then, you can send a core from any opposing Grandwalker Nexus to the Void.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [True Spellbind] or [True Spellbind: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [True Spellbind]", "give [True Spellbind]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
